digest.component_or_area: Bedrock provider parity measurement and first-class provider certification
propositions: Bedrock must clear a non-inferiority parity bar (structured-output validity, zero decision-level flips on gold set, recall/false-accept within margins, zero runtime error rate, gold coverage >= 20) before becoming a first-class provider in S8.

The parity measurement requires payload equivalence and tool parity across Bedrock and direct Anthropic for both standard (sonnet) and frontier (opus) model classes, with captured request evidence and enumerated envelope differences only.
Provider routing must be provably clean: the v2 (Bedrock) arm must make zero non-Bedrock calls across all case-runs, verified by per-call model tally from REBAR_USAGE_LOG.
Any capability difference that alters the payload (e.g., temperature withdrawal on opus via supports_temperature: False) must be explicit, symmetric across providers, and recorded rather than silent.

Both Bedrock inference-profile ids (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 via Step-1 probe before corpus spend, with bare on-demand ids rejected and temperature=0 probe executed.
